fact_rationales.F14: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody is more commonly associated with autoimmune conditions, which could support Autoimmune Encephalitis (B2.4) and Multiple Sclerosis (B2.1).
fact_rationales.F19: The presence of 4 oligoclonal bands in the CSF analysis is highly suggestive of Multiple Sclerosis (B2.1), as it indicates an abnormal immune response within the central nervous system.
fact_rationales.F25: Extensive white matter changes with enhancement along the arachnoid surface are consistent with several conditions, including Multiple Sclerosis (B2.1) and Autoimmune Encephalitis (B2.4), but are less typical for Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (B2.2) and Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (B2.3).
fact_rationales.F31: The presence of lymphocytes, plasma cells, and Russell bodies in the brain biopsy suggests an inflammatory process, which could be seen in Autoimmune Encephalitis (B2.4) and, to a lesser extent, in Multiple Sclerosis (B2.1).
